$comment: Slice-1 mirror of the @hues ref layer (see SWAP.md). Two namespaces: `design` holds the design-system ref values quoted in the slice brief §3; `seeds` holds seeds' live values from v2/app/globals.css @theme, ported as-is. Namespaces exist so the ink-soft collision (design #71806c vs seeds #4a4438) cannot silently merge.

seeds-ground.note: Brief §3: the seeds directory ground. Taken as sys.color.bg per Dustin's Q3 ruling (the conversion's only color delta).

seeds-link.note: Brief §3: design-system default for sys.color.link. Seeds keeps its live link #1f5c3d (theme.seeds.json); recorded here as the named ref endpoint.

fern.note: Brief §3: design-system default for sys.color.accent. Seeds keeps its live leaf-600 #2e6b4f; recorded here as the named ref endpoint.

seeds-deep.note: Brief §3: design-system default for sys.color.accent-strong. Seeds keeps its live leaf #1e4634; recorded here as the named ref endpoint.

seeds-muted.note: Brief §3: design-system default for sys.color.text-muted. Seeds keeps its live muted #6a5f4c; recorded here as the named ref endpoint.

gold-ink.note: Brief §3: design-system default for sys.color.accent-ink. Seeds keeps its live warn #8a5e08; recorded here as the named ref endpoint.

ink-soft.note: Brief §3: design-system default for sys.color.border-field. NOT seeds' live ink-soft (#4a4438, refs.seeds.ink-soft) — same stem, different value.

paper.note: Live ground (v2 @theme --color-paper), superseded as the ground by design.seeds-ground per Q3. Kept as the audit record of the delta.

ink-soft.note: v2 @theme --color-ink-soft (body text on paper-deep/footer/tab-bar; PB-A filled-field border). NOT design.ink-soft (#71806c).

stem-rule.note: v2 @theme --color-stem-rule (frozen retired line-strong RGB; do not re-derive).
